capabilities: show a lock icon on the pinned note's more options button
turn the button red while the note is pinned
restore the normal icon and color when the tab is unpinned
track pin state separately for each leaf in multi-pane layouts
react to pin changes via workspace events without polling
disambiguation: It does not pin, lock, or protect anything itself; it only makes Obsidian's existing pinned state visible on the note header.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README explains why a pure CSS snippet cannot achieve the same effect and lists many similarly named pinned-tab plugins it does not duplicate.
intentEvidence: This plugin reads Obsidian's own leaf.pinned flag and reflects it on the note's more options button.
problem: Obsidian marks pinned tabs only with a small icon in the tab bar, which is effectively invisible on a phone, so you cannot tell at a glance whether the open note is pinned.
summary: Tab pin indicator that shows a red lock icon on the note's more options button while the current note's tab is pinned.
